refund_policy: No refunds on any service; all transactions final
time_limit: None on forex & equities; futures evaluation max 90 calendar days (365-day add-on on $400K)
scaling_plan: Account doubling: after first withdrawal, 3 months >2% gain in any rolling 6 months, and total profits >=10% of start → account reopens at 2x size; cap $5M; only direct sizes up to $1M scale
hedging: allowed within a single account only
inactivity_rule: Open or close at least one trade every 30 days or account is breached
notes: Payout methods not published on public site. Equities min payout $100. Funded accounts issued 24-48 business hours after KYC and trader agreement. Weekend holding (forex) is a paid checkout add-on; 90% split is a paid add-on. Multi-accounting prohibited (all accounts closed).
